versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of coze-image, an image generation tool powered by the Coze API.
- Supports text-to-image generation via a configurable image generation workflow.
- Triggered by user requests such as "生成图片", "AI画图", or "用Coze生成图片".
- Returns an image URL in the format `https://s.coze.cn/t/xxx/`.
